text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky has managed to leave quite
a mark
on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been the center of attention since
before
her debut, but now she's even
more renowned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, in the midst of all this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM! Screeeech!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sorry I'm late, Trainer! Come on! Get in!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sorry I'm late, Trainer! Come on! Get in!
choice_data_list: 今日はどこに行くんだ……？

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well... last time we went to the sea, so I
think the
mountains would be a good
choice!
choice_data_list: 今日はどこに行くんだ……？

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But more importantly... why do you look
so
scared?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chillax over there! I always obey the
rules of the
road, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Sure, my driving might be a little hectic
at times,
but Tata gets restless!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We're here! Isn't hitting the redline with
Tata just
the best?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's start training, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't it obvious?
choice_data_list: なんで最近、出先でトレーニングするんだ？
なんで最近、出先でトレーニングするの？
choice_data_list_en: Why have you been training on the go lately?
Why have you been training while we're out lately?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I love taking drives, but I also want to
train!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've got so many exciting rivals now, and
there's
some really big races coming up,
right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm itching to get out there and run like
a speed
demon!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! My rivals are still trying to
catch up, so I
can't slow down now!
choice_data_list: 楽しい気持ちが伝わってくるよ
choice_data_list_en: I can really tell how much fun you're having.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But I don't just practice for them—it's for
you too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But I don't just practice for them—it's for
you too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I want you to always take pride in being
my
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Good! We're going to have a blast!

こっちも精いっぱい応えるよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll give it everything I've got in response!
